title: Course Schedule II
prompt: Return a valid order to finish all courses given prerequisite pairs, or an empty array if impossible.
hints: This is a topological ordering problem.
Track indegrees and process nodes with no remaining prerequisites.

title: Network Delay Time
prompt: Given travel times as directed edges, compute how long it takes for a signal to reach all nodes.
hints: You need shortest paths from a single starting node.
A min-heap is a good tool for exploring the next cheapest path.
